player_prompt.intro:
U nyaka {role} eColonel Blotto.
Vuswona bya wena ku nyika raundi ngalana na mpfana wakwe.
Eraundi, nyika mahala yin'we {num_total_units} units eka tifilihta {field_names}.
Nyika a nyikaka units ngalana eka ifild, ndyangu wa ifild, na nyika a nyikaka ifild ngalana ndyangu wa raundi.
Ku ringana, '[A7 B7 C6]' ku nyika 7 units eA, 7 eB, na 6 eC.
player_prompt.commander_alpha: Ndhuna ya Vuthu ra le Matini Alpha
